name: ChiarOscuro
source:
When a murder shakes his neighborhood, Morvayn, a loving husband and father, descends into complete darkness. Enter a world warped by his psychosis, where your mind can no longer tell truth from deception.

[From [url=https://blackclown.itch.io/chiaoscuro]Itch.io[/url]]
